tool.name: Solvent Density Calculator
tool.description: Calculates solvent density around the protein
tool.command:
ln -s '$parm_file' input.parm7 && ln -s '$rst_file' input.rst7 && ln -s '$rism_file' input.rism && ln -s '$xvv_file' cSPCE_kh.xvv &&
sander -O -i input.rism -o out.kh.r3d -p input.parm7 -c input.rst7 -xvv cSPCE_kh.xvv -guv out.kh && mv mdinfo '$mdinfo' && mv out.kh.r3d '$r_three_d_file' && mv out.kh.H1.0.dx '$out_kh_H1_0_dx' && mv out.kh.O.0.dx '$out_kh_O_0_dx'

param.name: rism_file
param.label: RISM input parameters file
param.help: Upload the RISM input file containing solvation parameters and calculations.

param.name: parm_file
param.label: AMBER Parm7 topology file
param.help: Upload the AMBER Parm7 topology file defining the force field and molecular structure.

param.name: rst_file
param.label: AMBER Rst7 coordinate file
param.help: Upload the AMBER Rst7 restart file containing atomic coordinates.

param.name: xvv_file
param.label: Water model parameters file
param.help: Upload the water model file for custom solvation parameters (e.g., cSPCE, SPC/E models).

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Calculates solvent density distribution around a protein using RISM (Reference Interaction Site Model) theory. This tool performs 3D-RISM calculations to generate KH potential maps showing favorable solvation sites and hydration patterns around the protein.
-----
**Key Features**
- **3D-RISM calculations**: Computes detailed solvation structure using integral equation theory - **Multi-site water models**: Supports different water models (cSPCE, SPC/E, etc.) - **Density maps**: Generates separate maps for different solvent atoms (O, H1) - **Laplacian analysis**: Calculates spatial derivatives for structure identification - **Bulk reference**: Accounts for bulk solvent properties in calculations
-----
**Inputs**
- **RISM input file**: File containing 3D-RISM parameters and input settings - **AMBER Parm7 topology**: Force field parameters and atom definitions - **AMBER Rst7 coordinates**: Initial atomic positions and system geometry - **Water model file** (optional): Custom solvent parameters (uses default cSPCE if not provided)
-----
**Outputs**
- **KH O-atom density map (out.kh.O.0.dx)**: Density distribution of oxygen atoms - **KH H-atom density map (out.kh.H1.0.dx)**: Density distribution of hydrogen atoms - **3D RISM structure file (out.kh.r3d)**: Full 3D-RISM results - **Sander info file (mdinfo)**: Calculation details and convergence information
-----
**Notes**
- RISM calculations can be computationally intensive for large systems - Output maps are in OpenDX format for visualization - Results depend on accuracy of input topology and coordinates - Bulk concentration affects solvation structure predictions
